caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical jar with a wide, slightly flared rim and a thick base. The jar is rendered in shades of brown, with darker brown tones indicating shadows and a lighter brown suggesting highlights that give the object a wooden or ceramic appearance. The texture on the jar has a subtle grain, enhancing the sense of material. The jar is situated centrally against a plain, light beige background. It casts a soft shadow directly below and to the side, positioned on a horizontal, rectangular dark brown surface. Above the jar, grey uppercase text reads: "SNUFF JAR EARLY 19th. CENTURY." The composition is balanced and focused, showing only the jar, the background, and the text, with no other objects present.
title: Snuff Jar
